The scatterplot shows the relationship between two variables, $x$ and $y$. A line of best fit for the data is also shown. For how many of the $10$ data points is the actual y-value greater than the y-value predicted by the line of best fit?
explanation: Choice C is correct. Any data point located above the line of best fit has an actual y-value that is greater than the y-value predicted by the line of best fit. For the scatterplot shown, $7$ of the $10$ data points are above the line of best fit. Therefore, $7$ data points have an actual y-value that is greater than the y-value predicted by the line of best fit.
